textField: Tensile strength in the ECM comes from *collagen* fibres, while *elastin* provides elastic recoil. Resistance to compression comes from a hydrated gel of *glycosaminoglycans* and proteoglycans, and cells anchor to the matrix through adhesive glycoproteins that bind cell-surface receptors called *integrins*.

overallFeedback.feedback: Collagen provides tensile strength and elastin provides recoil; a hydrated gel of glycosaminoglycans and proteoglycans resists compression; and cells anchor to the matrix through integrins, the cell-surface receptors that bind adhesive glycoproteins such as fibronectin and laminin.
